svg.title: ConvNeXt-Tiny architecture
svg.desc: ConvNeXt-Tiny: patchify stem, four stages of ConvNeXt blocks with downsampling, and classification head.

g.text: LayerNorm → global avg pool → FC 768 → 10 classes

svg.text: 28.6M params — 95.08% top-1 (highest in benchmark). Uses LayerNorm not BatchNorm; no MaxPool.
